map.耗电量 = 功率（W）× 使用时长（小时）÷ 1000，即 1 kWh 相当于: Energy consumption = power (W) × usage time (hours) ÷ 1000, i.e., 1 kWh equals running 1000 W for 1 hour; electricity cost = energy consumption × price; average hourly consumption = energy consumption ÷ usage hours; monthly cost can be estimated on a 30-day basis.
map.注意 W→kW 除以 1000。: Note the W→kW conversion by dividing by 1000.

map.冰箱 1 kWh/日、空调 9 kWh/日、其余 5 kWh/日：日总 15 k: Fridge 1 kWh/day, air conditioner 9 kWh/day, others 5 kWh/day: daily total 15 kWh, monthly 450 kWh, annual 5475 kWh. The fridge accounts for about 6.7% while the air conditioner is nearly 60%, so prioritize optimizing the air conditioner and standby. Tip: only itemized metering enables precise energy saving.
map.怎么快速降能耗？: How to quickly reduce energy consumption?
map.先找占比最大项（常是空调/采暖/热水），优化使用与设备效率，再清待机，收益最高。: First find the largest share (often air conditioning/heating/hot water), optimize its usage and equipment efficiency, then clear standby—this yields the highest returns.
map.年度能耗怎么估更准？: How to estimate annual energy consumption more accurately?
map.按季节分项加权（夏冬高、春秋低），或用智能电表实测，比简单乘 12 更准。: Weight itemized data by season (high in summer/winter, low in spring/autumn), or use actual smart meter measurements; both are more accurate than simply multiplying by 12.
